differences: The registered adapter now performs provider HEAD metadata discovery and raw image acquisition; the checked-in offline fixture is injected only by tests.
MY exposes current station endpoints only; explicit historical queries are rejected before any HEAD request.
The legacy Last-Modified minus nine minute rule is preserved and labeled unverified; request time is never used as a fallback.
The retained source PNGs are legacy acquisition artifacts and cannot establish a native scientific palette or geometry by themselves.

A fresh audit found two ignored legacy files with .gif suffixes, but their signatures are PNG; their hashes, dimensions, rendered labels, and timestamp discrepancy are documented in migration/blockers/my.md. They are not canonical provider responses and were not copied into fixtures.

The public image route returns rendered imagery; its copyright notice requires prior written consent for reproduction, and the visible timestamp/projection label does not provide native grid control points.

A 2026-09-21 raw-only CLI run acquired both public station endpoints with TLS verification enabled. Both advertise image/gif but return valid PNG payloads; the adapter records both media types and only accepts PNG signatures.

Live raw bytes were hashed and inspected in a temporary output directory, then deleted because no reuse permission is present. Exact response times, dimensions, hashes, and CLI status are in validation-results/live-cli-my.json.

The official Web Service API documents general forecasts and refers requests for other meteorological data to METMalaysia; it does not document a public radar endpoint. myMETdata lists Rainbow-native radar data as a paid product.
blockers: No canonical upstream GIF and discovery response with a documented reuse basis are available; the local PNGs are rendered historical outputs.
The legacy Last-Modified minus nine-minute rule is unverified, and no machine-readable upstream frame time has been retained.
Native projection pixel control points are unavailable; the rendered image labels alone do not establish a usable grid transform or palette semantics.
No written reuse permission or licensed sample is present; the official portal copyright notice requires express prior written consent for reproduction.
Live payloads are deleted after temporary CLI validation because no reuse permission is available.
